author: Animalogic
description:
What if everything we thought we knew about animals was wrong? Why do monarch butterflies disappear, what are our cats really trying to tell us, and why do goldfish grow into giants in the wild? From mysterious animal behavior to surprising wildlife discoveries, these stories reveal just how much we still don't know about the creatures sharing our planet.

00:00 - We Were Wrong About What's Killing Monarchs
17:46 - Where do Bugs Go In the Winter?
25:57 - We've Been Misreading What Our Cats Are Saying
41:47 - The Most Bullied Animal In The Internet Is Full Of Secrets
55:10 - Why Goldfish Get So Big In The Wild
1:18:25 - We Were Wrong About Eastern Cougars
1:35:45 - Why Are There Penguins in South America's Deserts?
